title: Puthoff visited Ossining and heard about the Nine

tellings.quote: Puthoff tells us that he went to Puharich's house in Ossining, heard all about the nine,

plain: Sometime in the 1970s, the scientist Hal Puthoff is said to have gone to the home of a man named Puharich in Ossining, New York, and heard there all about "the Nine", which the episode presents as a council of alien beings that people claimed to be in contact with. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this second-hand: he says Puthoff himself told him and his colleagues that he went to the house and "heard all about the nine." If true, it would put a serious scientist in the room while these contact claims were taking shape.
